capabilities: Highlight the current sentence during playback
Preserve folder structure and convert wiki-links
Embed images and audio as data URIs
disambiguation: Not only a read-aloud TTS tool; its core job is exporting notes to self-contained offline HTML pages, with narration as an optional mode.
extras: TTS is optional and off by default; enabling it sends note sentences to Volcengine's cloud speech API, while plain HTML export runs fully locally. Desktop-first with no mobile support yet; manual install only (main.js + manifest.json).
intentEvidence: this fork adds the Read Along (语音伴读) branding and features
problem: Crowded Markdown notes lack a clean, comfortable reading format, and long notes can't be listened to while reading offline.

relations.evidence: Based on the open-source project notes-to-html-pages by Afan (MIT)
the note's sentences are sent to Volcengine's (火山引擎) speech-synthesis API

requires.name: Volcengine (火山引擎) speech-synthesis API key

summary: Exporter that turns Markdown notes into self-contained offline HTML reading pages, with optional sentence-by-sentence TTS narration and synced highlighting.
